towers.name: Manchester Airport (hybrid digital tower)

dates.t: Announced
Digital apron management due to go live

facts.t: Hybrid digital control tower with camera arrays on Terminal 2 piers; the release says the apron system is due to go live in 2026.

towers.note: Hybrid means controllers keep the window view and add video; it is not a remote tower. Go-live not confirmed.

dates.t: Test in summer 2015

facts.t: The town says air traffic control has been provided since 2018 through the FAA remote tower program (nearly 80,000 operations a year) and that the FAA discontinued the program in June 2023.
A temporary tower is in place; the permanent tower is estimated to finish in spring 2029.
Saab stopped being the provider after the FAA changed certification standards.

towers.name: Bartow Executive Airport (Digital Tower Operations Center)

dates.t: Frequentis installation (project March 2023 to November 2025)
Active control testing planned
Full services targeted

facts.t: Installed at Bartow; active control testing was slated for January 2026 and full air traffic control services were targeted for July 2026.
Frequentis reports its X10 voice system went live there; the CANSO story is dated 12 March 2026.

towers.note: The FAA states that no remote tower system was approved for the NAS as of its February 2025 page. See the United States program page for the September 2026 design approval.

dates.t: Control testing for Winter Haven scheduled to begin

facts.t: Winter Haven is intended to be operated from the Bartow centre; Florida DOT is funding the system and officials hoped for approval in 2026.
Control testing for Winter Haven was scheduled to begin in July 2026.

connections.name: Bartow Executive Airport (Digital Tower Operations Center)

towers.name: FAA William J. Hughes Technical Center (Atlantic City)

facts.t: The FAA evaluates remote tower systems at the Technical Center and selected RTX-Frequentis for system design approval evaluation and operational testing.
The FAA states that manufacturers submit designs which it evaluates at the Technical Center.

towers.name: Johnston Regional Airport

dates.t: Local reporting on a digital tower plan

facts.t: The airport has FAA approval for a traditional tower but hopes the FAA approves digital towers; the director estimates a digital tower at about half the cost.

towers.name: Western Sydney International Airport

facts.t: Over 20 cameras at the airport feed a Digital Aerodrome Service at Eastern Creek; CDC and Frequentis Australasia work with Airservices.

towers.note: Airport opening date and ATC go-live not confirmed here.

towers.note: Trial dates are not given in the source; later outcome not confirmed.
